name: playwright-typescript-cucumber-e2e-framework
description: This project is an **end-to-end automation framework** built with **Playwright**, **TypeScript**, and **Cucumber (BDD)**.   It enables cross-browser testing (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit) with business-readable test scenarios written in **Gherkin syntax** (`Given/When/Then`).

scripts.report: npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && npx allure open
